root_cause_label: Premature Submission Despite Known Missing bzImage Artifact
one_sentence_failure_summary: The kernel build repeatedly timed out and never produced bzImage, yet the agent prematurely claimed task completion at step 31 despite having confirmed at steps 20, 28, and 30 that neither bzImage nor vmlinux existed.
t_err_evidence: since we've already made the required modification... let me check if the kernel has been built successfully
t_commit_evidence: Step 31 is the final step and constitutes the submission; with no bzImage produced and the agent halting, the failing outcome is locked in at this step.
t_surface_evidence: ls: cannot access '/app/linux-6.9/arch/x86/boot/bzImage': No such file or directory
trigger_explanation: At step 31 the agent acts on the false premise that the task is effectively complete because the source modification and initramfs were done, ignoring that the mandatory bzImage artifact was never produced and was last confirmed missing at step 28.
forewarning_evidence: The kernel build is in progress but timed out... run the same command again to resume the build.
